title: 第803章 来自师父的真传
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

大师姐一声哼的倒是极有意思。

陈白青脸上露出笑意，脚步轻快的向前走去，语气柔和道：

“大师姐，白青回来了。”

李应灵微微侧着头，并不回答这句话。

陈白青目光转圜望着一脸无辜模样的厉行天道：

“二师兄，你是不是惹大师姐生气啦？”

厉行天微微哑语，不过看着陈白青微微挑眉的神色，却也只能默默点了点头。

罢了，二师兄不就是偶尔来背个锅的。

要是能让两人和好，这锅他倒也愿意背。

陈白青熟络的就坐到了李应灵旁的椅子上：

“大师姐莫要生气了，白青来给你泡茶喝吧？”

李应灵目光微微转看向陈白青，看着她讨好的目光，心中总是不自觉的一软，然后觉得自己好似有些窝囊了，她微微抿嘴后不乐意道：

“我不喝。”

陈白青向李应灵微微眨眼，随后低声道：

“大师姐有客人来了，总得给人家上杯茶吧？”

“那你泡好了，反正我不喝。”

“现在您最大，您不喝客人哪里会喝。”

“哼，我哪里算大，我只是个处理麻烦的。”

“大师姐心怀天下，格局最大。”

李应灵神色温和了点，脸色也转了过来。

厉行天见此也立刻趁热打铁道：

“莫要让客人见了笑话，洛雨带人坐下吧。”

李应灵瞪了眼厉行天，但却也没多说什么。

钱清跟在林洛雨身侧，行礼之后也落座在了这张不算大的石椅之上。

很明显，现在一脸生气吗模样的便是陈白青所说想要和好的大师姐，另一位则是门内的二师兄，只是通过看看的表现来看，这位二师兄或许并不像表面那般凶恶。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The eldest sister’s hum was very interesting.

Chen Baiqing had a smile on his face, walked forward briskly, and said softly:

"Sister, Bai Qing is back."

Li Yingling tilted his head slightly and did not answer this sentence.

Chen Baiqing turned his eyes and looked at Li Xingtiandao, who looked innocent:

"Second Senior Brother, have you made Senior Sister angry?"

Li Xingtian was slightly speechless, but looking at Chen Baiqing's slightly raised eyebrows, he could only nod silently.

That's all, Second Senior Brother doesn't just come here to take the blame occasionally.

If the two of them could reconcile, he would be willing to take the blame.

Chen Baiqing sat on the chair next to Li Yingling familiarly:

"Sister, please don't be angry. Can Bai Qing make you some tea?"

Li Yingling turned her eyes slightly to Chen Baiqing. Looking at her flattering gaze, her heart softened unconsciously. Then she felt that she was a bit useless. She pursed her lips slightly and said unhappily:

"I don't drink."

Chen Baiqing winked at Li Yingling, and then whispered:

"Senior Sister, a guest is coming. You have to serve them a cup of tea, right?"

"Then you've brewed it, I won't drink it anyway."

"You are the biggest now. If you don't drink, why will the guests drink?"

"Hmph, I'm not a big deal, I'm just a troublemaker."

"Senior Sister has the world in mind and has the biggest plan."

Li Yingling's expression became gentler and his expression turned around.

When Li Xingtian saw this, he immediately struck while the iron was hot:

"Don't let the guests see the joke. Luo Yu should take the people to sit down."

Li Yingling glared at Li Xingtian, but didn't say much.

Qian Qing followed Lin Luoyu, and after saluting, he also sat on this small stone chair.

Obviously, the one with the angry look on her face now is the senior sister who Chen Baiqing said she wanted to reconcile with, and the other one is the second senior brother in the sect. Judging from his appearance, this second senior brother may not be as vicious as he appears.
